label: Technology & Computers
description: Building apps, coding, exploring how software and hardware work.
pathway_note: Technology skills transfer into nearly every industry — you can combine coding with fashion, sports, healthcare, or music.

label: Gaming & Esports
description: Playing, designing, streaming, or competing in video games.
pathway_note: The gaming industry is larger than Hollywood. Roles range from art and storytelling to engineering and business.

label: Art & Drawing
description: Creating visual art through drawing, painting, illustration, or digital media.
pathway_note: Art skills power industries from advertising and film to medicine (medical illustrators) and law (forensic artists).

label: Music
description: Playing instruments, singing, composing, or producing music.
pathway_note: Music careers span performance, business, technology, and therapy — formal training or self-taught paths both lead to real careers.

label: Writing & Storytelling
description: Crafting stories, essays, journalism, or creative content.
pathway_note: Every organization needs writers. Strong writing skills open doors in law, tech, healthcare, policy, and entertainment.

label: Film & Video
description: Making, editing, or directing videos and films.
pathway_note: Video production skills are in high demand for corporate, nonprofit, entertainment, and social media sectors.

label: Fashion & Style
description: Designing clothing, styling outfits, or following fashion trends.
pathway_note: Fashion connects to business, sustainability, technology (wearable tech), and psychology (color theory, consumer behavior).

label: Beauty & Wellness
description: Skincare, makeup, hair, and personal wellness routines.
pathway_note: Beauty is a $500B global industry. Business, chemistry (cosmetic formulation), and healthcare all connect here.

label: Team Sports
description: Competing in or following team sports like football, basketball, soccer, or volleyball.
pathway_note: Very few athletes go pro — but sports management, sports medicine, analytics, and media offer thousands of stable careers.

label: Individual Sports & Fitness
description: Solo athletic pursuits like swimming, track, tennis, golf, or martial arts.
pathway_note: Individual sport backgrounds develop mental toughness prized in healthcare, coaching, and performance consulting roles.

label: Outdoors & Nature
description: Hiking, camping, wildlife observation, conservation, and time in natural settings.
pathway_note: Climate change is driving demand for environmental careers across government, nonprofits, and private sector.

label: Animals & Pets
description: Caring for, training, or studying animals.
pathway_note: Animal careers range from hands-on care to research science. Vet techs are in high demand and a 2-year degree path is available.

label: Cooking & Food
description: Cooking, baking, food science, or exploring cuisines from around the world.
pathway_note: Food connects to science, business, media, and culture. Culinary schools, nutrition degrees, and food science programs all lead here.

label: Travel & Cultures
description: Exploring different places, learning about cultures, and experiencing the world.
pathway_note: International careers span diplomacy, hospitality, business, and journalism. Bilingual candidates are especially competitive.

label: Helping & Counseling
description: Supporting others emotionally, mentoring peers, or volunteering in the community.
pathway_note: Mental health careers are among the fastest-growing fields. Many roles are accessible with a bachelor's or master's degree.

label: Medicine & Health
description: How the body works, treating illness, and improving health outcomes.
pathway_note: Healthcare is one of the largest US employers. Clinical and non-clinical pathways (admin, informatics, policy) both offer stable careers.

label: Biology & Life Sciences
description: How living things work, from cells to ecosystems.
pathway_note: Biology powers healthcare, agriculture, biotech, and environmental science. Research and applied roles both have strong job markets.

label: Chemistry & Materials
description: Chemical reactions, materials, lab work, and the molecular world.
pathway_note: Chemistry underlies manufacturing, medicine, energy, and consumer goods. Many entry-level roles are available with a bachelor's degree.

label: Space & Astronomy
description: The universe, planets, stars, and space exploration.
pathway_note: Space is booming with private companies (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Rocket Lab) creating thousands of engineering and operations roles.

label: Math & Logic
description: Solving puzzles, proofs, statistics, and mathematical patterns.
pathway_note: Math is the gateway to the highest-paying careers across finance, tech, and science. Actuaries in particular have structured, high-income career paths.

label: Building & Engineering
description: Designing and building physical things — machines, structures, or devices.
pathway_note: Engineering degrees have among the highest starting salaries. Engineering technician roles (2-year degree) are also well-paying.

label: Environment & Sustainability
description: Climate change, renewable energy, conservation, and sustainable systems.
pathway_note: The green economy is one of the fastest-growing job sectors. Roles exist in engineering, law, finance, and policy.

label: Farming & Agriculture
description: Growing food, managing land, and understanding agricultural systems.
pathway_note: Modern agriculture combines technology (drones, sensors, data) with traditional knowledge. Agri-tech is a fast-growing sector.

label: Business & Entrepreneurship
description: Starting ventures, selling, marketing, and understanding how businesses operate.
pathway_note: Business degrees are versatile. Entrepreneurship doesn't require a specific major — many successful founders come from engineering, design, or liberal arts.

label: Finance & Investing
description: Stocks, budgeting, economics, and understanding how money works.
pathway_note: Finance careers span Wall Street to Main Street. CPA, CFA, and CFP credentials open doors beyond a finance degree alone.

label: Law & Justice
description: Legal systems, fairness, rights, debate, and advocacy.
pathway_note: Law school follows any bachelor's degree. Pre-law students benefit from majors in political science, philosophy, history, or economics.

label: Politics & Government
description: Policy, elections, civic engagement, and public service.
pathway_note: Government careers are stable and mission-driven. Paths include civil service, elected office, military, and nonprofit sectors.

label: Military & Service
description: Serving the country through military, first responder, or public safety roles.
pathway_note: Military service funds college education, provides career training, and opens doors to federal civilian careers. Service academies (West Point, Naval Academy) are highly competitive.

label: Teaching & Education
description: Explaining concepts, mentoring students, and designing learning experiences.
pathway_note: Teaching is universally needed and deeply impactful. Advanced degrees open doors to higher education, policy, and leadership roles.

label: Research & Discovery
description: Asking questions, running experiments, and advancing knowledge.
pathway_note: Research careers often require graduate degrees, but research assistant roles are available with a bachelor's. Industry (pharma, tech) research can pay very well.

label: Architecture & Design
description: Designing buildings, spaces, interiors, and urban environments.
pathway_note: Architecture requires a 5-year professional degree and licensure. Interior design and urban planning have shorter paths.

label: Social Media & Content Creation
description: Building online audiences, creating digital content, and growing brands.
pathway_note: Content creation is a career, not just a hobby. Creators who understand analytics and business strategy build sustainable careers.

label: Psychology & Human Behavior
description: Why people think, feel, and behave the way they do.
pathway_note: Psychology is one of the most popular majors and connects to healthcare, tech (UX), business, and education.

label: History & Culture
description: The past, civilizations, cultural heritage, and how societies change over time.
pathway_note: History majors develop research and analysis skills valued in law, government, journalism, and management consulting.

label: Languages & Linguistics
description: Learning foreign languages, understanding how language works, or translation.
pathway_note: Bilingual and multilingual professionals command salary premiums in diplomacy, healthcare, law, and technology.

label: Philosophy & Ethics
description: Big questions about right and wrong, meaning, knowledge, and existence.
pathway_note: Philosophy is the best pre-law major by GPA in law school. AI ethics is a fast-growing specialty as technology raises new moral questions.

label: Dance & Performance
description: Dancing, acting, musical theater, or performing arts of any kind.
pathway_note: Performing arts trains discipline, collaboration, and public speaking — skills valued across all industries even if performance isn't the career.

label: Crafts & Maker Culture
description: 3D printing, woodworking, jewelry making, textile arts, and DIY creation.
pathway_note: Maker skills translate directly to manufacturing, product design, and technical theater careers. Etsy-to-business paths are increasingly viable.

label: Robotics & Automation
description: Building robots, coding automated systems, and working with mechatronics.
pathway_note: Robotics skills are foundational to manufacturing, healthcare (surgical robots), defense, and logistics automation.

label: Data & Analytics
description: Finding patterns in data, visualizing insights, and making data-driven decisions.
pathway_note: Data skills are valued in every industry. Many data analyst roles are accessible with a bachelor's degree and portfolio projects.

label: Skilled Trades
description: Electrical work, plumbing, welding, HVAC, automotive, and hands-on technical crafts.
pathway_note: Trades earn excellent wages ($50K-$100K+) without four-year degree debt. Apprenticeships pay while you learn. Licensed trades are recession-resistant.

label: Cybersecurity & Hacking
description: Protecting systems, ethical hacking, and digital security.
pathway_note: Cybersecurity has a massive talent shortage. Certifications (CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+) combined with a degree lead to six-figure salaries.

label: Nursing & Patient Care
description: Direct patient care, bedside manner, and clinical support roles.
pathway_note: Nursing is one of the most job-secure professions. ADN programs (2-year) allow faster entry; BSN opens management and NP paths.

label: Startups & Innovation
description: Creating new products, disrupting markets, and building companies from scratch.
pathway_note: Startup experience is gained at any age. Entrepreneurship programs at universities provide structure; accelerators and incubators provide funding.

label: Real Estate & Construction
description: Property, development, construction management, and urban development.
pathway_note: Real estate doesn't require a four-year degree for entry. A real estate license can be earned in months; development paths benefit from business or engineering degrees.
